title: الأحياء في المملكة العربية السعودية (Districts / Neighborhoods of Saudi Arabia)
description: قائمة الأحياء (الحي = neighbourhood / sub-city) في مدن المملكة العربية السعودية المتاحة في سجل Manateq. National catalog of districts / neighbourhoods (أحياء / aḥyāʾ — singular حي ḥayy) across cities of Saudi Arabia. Each record is joined to its parent city (city_id / city_ar / city_en / city_slug) and to the grandparent region (region_id / region_ar / region_en / region_slug) via the Manateq cities.json bridge table. Note: Manateq districts.json covers a sample of major-city districts (esp. Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Abha) rather than every district in every Saudi city; expect uneven coverage.
